hypothesis_text: Add a low-rank user-item interaction term to the existing additive logits: represent each known user and video with 16-dimensional embeddings and score each impression as bias plus additive user/item weights plus their embedding dot product, while retaining pointwise binary cross-entropy training and the current data split. This tests whether personalized user-video affinity improves within-user ordering over the additive-only model without changing labels or evaluation.
